title: crypto2dev: scaffolding and build integration
description: Create the directory structure, source/header files, configure flag, and Makefile rules for the crypto2dev CryptoCb shim. Mirrors the caliptra port layout at wolfcrypt/src/port/caliptra/. Includes: wolfcrypt/src/port/crypto2dev/crypto2dev_port.c, wolfssl/wolfcrypt/port/crypto2dev/crypto2dev_port.h, --enable-crypto2dev configure flag (sets WOLFSSL_CRYPTO2DEV + WOLF_CRYPTO_CB + WOLF_CRYPTO_CB_FREE + WOLF_CRYPTO_CB_SETKEY), wolfcrypt/src/include.am entry, device ID constant (WOLF_CRYPTO2DEV_DEVID), wc_crypto2dev_init()/cleanup() lifecycle stubs, and wc_crypto2dev_cb() entry point skeleton with algo_type dispatch.
notes: Model after wolfcrypt/src/port/caliptra/caliptra_port.c structure. Device ID should be a 4-byte ASCII constant to avoid collision with small positive IDs.
